turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi. I recently got a premium membership with you. I need to pay my bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. May I have your name please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure. My name is Sanya Afzal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also have your account ID and Order ID?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Sanya Afzal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Absolutely. Account ID: LQMM3PSB0E and Order ID: 5411650958

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And how much do you want to pay today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd just like to pay the full amount. Sorry I was never told what the subscription fee is.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for subscription status ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok that will be $20. Do you have a CC?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I do not have a credit card on hand. Can you use the one on my account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I sure can. One moment please.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been updated with renew subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright everything is all paid. Is there anything else i can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh thank you so much! That was all I needed today.
